newsitem.title: USA: ClinTrials sees Q2 loss with fewer deals.
newsitem.headline: ClinTrials sees Q2 loss with fewer deals.

text.p: ClinTrials Research Inc said Friday it expected to report a loss in the second quarter as a result of contract cancellations.

But ClinTrials, which provides contract research services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device companies, said its first-quarter earnings would likely remain consistent with the estimate of $0.04-a-share that it announced last month. Revenues for the period should reach about $28 million, it said.
First Call's consensus among industry analysts also foresees $0.04 a share for the first quarter.

For the same period last year, it had reported earnings at $0.12 a share on revenues of $17.7 million. The company eventually revised the figure to $0.08 to take into account a 33-percent increase in the number of shares outstanding.
ClinTrials also said it expected a profit between $0.06 a share and $0.10 on revenues of about $110 million for all of 1997.
"As a result of the contract cancellations we will experience poor earnings comparisons for the balance of 1997," it said, adding that the cancellations were worth $27 million.
The company said the cancellations were due to reasons beyond its control. "None of the cancellations were related to quality or service," it added.
